# Helena Insulation

> Helena Insulation is a Montana-based insulation contractor founded in 1978, specializing in cellulose, fiberglass, and spray foam insulation services with comprehensive technical education and industry partnerships.

Helena Insulation provides energy-efficient insulation solutions for residential and commercial applications, offering multiple product types including blown cellulose, fiberglass batts, and spray foam systems. The company emphasizes technical knowledge and safety standards through educational resources and partnerships with industry leaders like Applegate Insulation.

## Key Topics

- Cellulose Insulation
- Spray Foam
- Blown Fiberglass
- Fiberglass Batts
- Energy Efficiency
- Insulation Removal
- Commercial Services
- Product Safety
- Technical Specifications
- Blower Door Tests
- Fireproofing
- Water-proofing
- K-13 Product
- Applegate Partnership
- Consumer Education
